data: Seven generated 3-minute non-speech tracks (benchmarks/prepare_muted.py): digital silence, self-noise, room noise, keyboard clicks, mains hum, modulated breathing noise, fan noise. All synthetic; not a real muted microphone.
change: Bracketed sound annotations and caption sign-offs (for example '(air whooshing)', 'Thank you for watching') are kept as evidence but not published. Energy gating was rejected: genuine quiet backchannels have lower RMS (0.0016) than the hallucinating chunks (0.0036). large-v3 reports no_speech_probability of 0, so that signal cannot be used with it.
remaining: large-v3 still prints 'Satsang with Mooji' and 'Thank you.' on the breathing track; AMI WER is unchanged by the filter (small.en 20.28%, large-v3 19.52%).
